post.description:
The sender confirms (7.3 step 7); a re-solve starts when the roster inputs changed, and
the roster agent takes over the workflow. With nothing published yet the request just queues
for the next Generate.
The parse was wrong (sender), or the charge nurse declines a leave or swap.

The charge nurse approves a leave or swap (Q7); a waiting agent task continues with the
re-solve this starts.

Publish the run of the chosen candidate (Approve = the top one, 6.5); `nurse_id` null
publishes the proposal's own run (a plain re-solve has no candidates).
Answer a why-question from tool results only; claims are checked (7.4).

post.description: Apply the chosen option (a waiver or a float nurse) and start a new run with it.

Approve the task's contact plan ("ask B, then C, then D"). This publishes nothing:
the first accept still comes back for one Publish.
Treat the task's open ask as timed out now; the cascade moves to the next nurse.
End the task without publishing: withdraw its open asks, mark it cancelled.

Turn down the run the task proposed: a conditional deal reopens the nurse's ask
as a plain follow-up, a plain accept ends the task. Publishes nothing.

get.description: Newest first, with each task's step trace (the Agent tab).

get.description: Messages to nurses (replacement and swap asks), newest first; all nurses when no id.

post.description:
Parse a "yes, if..." text through intake, restricted to one day off or one
shift to avoid for this nurse; answers the confirm chip, or a clarification.
The nurse taps Accept or Decline (or "yes, if..."); the waiting agent task continues.
The replacement's answer by proposal (10.1): the open ask to that nurse for this run.

get.description:
Nights, weekend shifts and denied requests per nurse: earlier published periods (carry-in)
and the current published roster, with the ward average over regular nurses.

Planned vs current (6.5c): every cell the current roster and each open proposal change
against the period's planned version, with the cause and the decision behind it.

post.description:
Muse Spark reads the photo into the current period's grid; nothing is stored. Cells it
could not read are "?", and days whose cells miss the printed totals are listed.
The corrected grid becomes the published, planned run (`kind = import`).

Minimum headcount, shortfall cells, standby shifts and per-nurse load for this period under
a what-if (hires, nurses out for the whole period, standby, target or floor). Nothing is
stored; the published roster is untouched. Every number is a lower bound (see `caveat`).
